title: Ticking Invoicing & payments Delete while View and Manage AP/AR Data is OFF prompts to turn it on
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role) with View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF.
custom_steps: 1. In the Invoicing & payments card, tick the Delete box while View and Manage AP/AR Data is off.
custom_expected: The system prompts you to turn on View and Manage AP/AR Data.
evidence: UI: ticking Invoicing & payments Delete/Reverse while View and Manage AP/AR Data is OFF shows NO prompt — invoicing Delete just turns ON and AP/AR stays off. The build gates Invoicing on See Financial Data (per the SFD-disable dialog), not on AP/AR. Case premise (AP/AR prompt) is stale/not implemented.
